candidates.name: Cameron Interstate Pipeline
candidates.from: Cameron LNG terminal, Hackberry, Cameron Parish, LA (interconnects with Tennessee Gas, Texas Eastern and others)
candidates.to: Cameron Parish / Calcasieu Parish, LA interconnects

evidence.note: Federal Register notice on Cameron LNG and Cameron Interstate Pipeline application
Terminal connected to five interstate pipelines via the 36-mile Cameron Interstate Pipeline; later 42-inch expansion

candidates.name: Florida Gas Transmission Phase III Expansion

evidence.note: Phase III described as $900 million, 530 MMcf/d, 815 miles of pipeline across LA, MS, AL, FL (OGJ text; figure may be total pipe incl. loops)
